label: playCheck
js: (() => { const t0 = performance.now(); const r = game.playCheck(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, total: r.total, failed: r.failed.slice(0, 8), ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0) }); })()

label: playCheck mirror (must fail)
js: (() => { const r = game.playCheck('mirror'); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, failedCount: r.failed.length, first: r.failed.slice(0, 2) }); })()

label: playCheck stuckShaft (must fail)
js: (() => { const r = game.playCheck('stuckShaft'); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, failedCount: r.failed.length, first: r.failed.slice(0, 3) }); })()

js: (() => { const r = game.playCheck('holdThrough'); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, failedCount: r.failed.length, first: r.failed.slice(0, 2) }); })()

js: (() => { const r = game.playCheck('waitFloor'); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, failedCount: r.failed.length, first: r.failed.slice(0, 2) }); })()

label: headless check in the page
js: (() => { const r = game.check(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, n: r.results.length, failed: r.failed }); })()
